integrity: The proof is analytic. Symbolic computation only verifies exact algebraic identities and the explicit sharpness-family series; it is not used as a substitute for an infinite argument.
scientific_limitations: Local planar stability only; no global-in-defect or higher-dimensional stability theorem is claimed. The principal residual originality risk is an unindexed stability result in a different metric whose conversion may imply the same coefficients.
title: Sharp second-order Gram stability for the planar three-vector signed-sum extremizer
